articles.title: Suchika Tariyal Wins India's First Asian Games MMA Medal - GKToday
articles.content: Home Suchika Tariyal Wins India’s First Asian Games MMA Medal Suchika Tariyal Wins India’s First Asian Games MMA Medal September 21, 2026 Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027 Suchika Tariyal won India’s first-ever Asian Games medal in mixed martial arts on 21 September 2026. She secured a bronze medal in the women’s traditional -60 kg category at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026, where MMA featured as a medal sport for the first time. Mixed Martial Arts at the Asian Games Mixed martial arts, or MMA, is a combat sport that combines techniques from striking and grappling disciplines. At the Asian Games, traditional MMA events award bronze medals to both losing semifinalists, and no separate bronze-medal bout is held. Suchika Tariyal’s Medal Route Tariyal reached the semifinals after defeating Mongolia’s Altanchimeg Baigalmaa 2-0 in the quarterfinals on 20 September 2026. She lost her semifinal bout to Singapore’s Hui Hoon Teo by a 0-2 margin in overtime on 21 September 2026. Suchika Tariyal’s Combat Sports Background Suchika Tariyal was 36 years old at the time of the medal. She represented India in judo at the 2022 Commonwealth Games, competed in kurash at the 2023 Asian Games, and won a Jiu-Jitsu world title in 2024. Important Facts for Exams MMA stands for mixed martial arts, a combat sport that includes striking and grappling techniques. The Asian Games are organised by the Olympic Council of Asia and are held once every four years. In traditional MMA at the Asian Games, both losing semifinalists receive bronze medals. Suchika Tariyal won India’s first Asian Games medal in MMA at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Tariyal’s bronze medal was won in the women’s traditional -60 kg category. MMA made its debut as a medal sport at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026.
